device.description: dual 8-bit multiplying current-output DAC with separate data latches and a common 8-bit microprocessor input port (10.8-15.75 V supply)
device.note: slas063b.pdf (SLAS063B) p.1 (pinout), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 10.8-15.75 V, TTL VIH 2.4 V / VIL 0.8 V, timing), p.4 (Figure 1 write timing), p.8 (microprocessor interface), p.9 (Table 1 mode selection, Tables 2-3 codes)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A data latch (DACA/DACB low, Table 1 p.9); power-on code not stated (0 used)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B data latch (DACA/DACB high, Table 1 p.9); power-on code not stated (0 used)

commands.name: Write (CS and WR low)
commands.note: DACA/DACB selects the latch (low = DACA, high = DACB); data latched when CS or WR goes high (p.8, Table 1 p.9)

pages: p.1 (pinout, DW or N package), p.3 (recommended operating conditions, timing requirements), p.4 (write timing), p.8-9 (interface, mode selection table)
notModeled: analog: multiplying current outputs OUTA/OUTB, references REFA/REFB (+-10 V), feedback resistors RFBA/RFBB, voltage-mode operation
the selected latch is transparent while CS and WR are low (the output follows DB7-DB0); the model latches at the end of the write
power-on contents of the data latches are not stated (0 used)
the digital inputs are TTL-compatible (VIH 2.4 V, VIL 0.8 V) with VDD 10.8-15.75 V; the vcc range is VDD
variants: TLC7528 is the 5-15 V counterpart with a separate datasheet; only the TLC7628C (0-70 C) is in this datasheet
